players.product: 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers (incl. 800G LPO) on in-house silicon photonics chips; 3.2T / 6.4T NPO engines in customer testing

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: 2025 revenue RMB 14,354,760,508.18, up 22.59%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,470,794,704.16, up 20.48% (excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,187,461,550.92, up 32.32%). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 3,355,471,582.66, Q2 RMB 4,273,528,617.17, Q3 RMB 3,408,981,251.74, Q4 RMB 3,316,779,056.61; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 149,486,549.68. By business: connectivity (optical) RMB 60.97 hundred million (+53.39%), sensing RMB 40.27 hundred million (+9.78%), intelligent manufacturing (laser equipment) RMB 36.36 hundred million (+4.13%). Overseas revenue RMB 2,010,244,611.63, up 45.52%, 14.00% of revenue.

2025 annual report: optoelectronic device products (the connectivity business) earned RMB 6,096,823,863.78, up 53.39%, 42.48% of revenue, at a 13.26% gross margin (up 4.85 points); the company says the growth came mainly from AI applications. It delivers its 800G silicon-photonics LPO series and 1.6T transceivers at scale ('global first tier', company claim) with its customer base and delivery share expanding; 800G ZR/ZR+ Pro coherent modules are in volume delivery; it launched 800G ACC and 1.6T AEC/ACC copper cable modules, and says it was first in the industry to introduce 1.6T 3nm FRO/LRO and 1.6T LPO solutions, 3.2T NPO and 3.2T CPO light engines and a 400G/lane light-engine solution.

2025 annual report: phase 1 of the Wuhan optoelectronic information industry R&D park, the Thailand overseas high-speed optical module base and the Xiaogan smart-terminal base were all completed and put into production. The largest construction-in-progress project, the next-generation ultra-high-speed optical module R&D center and high-speed optical module production base (budget RMB 48,562.40 ten-thousand, self-funded), was 84.34% complete at end-2025 with RMB 259,491,400.70 transferred to fixed assets in the year and RMB 150,107,979.27 still in progress; the Thailand plant fit-out (budget RMB 1,970.39 ten-thousand) was 100% complete. Inventory rose to RMB 3,581,241,659.54 as the company built strategic stock to meet order growth and raw-material supply fluctuation.
quarterly_data.figure: optical module base budget RMB 48,562.40 ten-thousand, 84.34% complete; inventory RMB 3,581,241,659.54

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: the company develops both silicon-photonics and thin-film lithium niobate chips in-house; its silicon-photonics chips are used in 400G, 800G and 1.6T transceiver deliveries, and it has highly integrated silicon-photonics chips for 3.2T CPO/NPO. It says it can transmit 400G per lane and has a single-wavelength 400G light engine, and has flip-chip, 2.5D and 3D packaging capability as the base for next-generation light engines and co-packaged optics.

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D investment RMB 1,091,561,114.87, up 9.96%, 7.60% of revenue, of which 18.96% capitalised; R&D staff 2,698 (28.51% of employees). Among its main projects, next-generation optical chips and high-end optical module series aims at self-controlled high-end optical chips and new satellite and automotive markets.

2025 annual report outlook: the company plans to speed up 3.2T/6.4T iteration, pursue silicon photonics, LPO and CPO routes in parallel and achieve in-house volume production of high-end optical chips, as hardware for global AI cloud vendors and supercomputing centers; to accelerate capacity release at its Thailand and Vietnam bases; and to develop large international customers. It flags that production depends on stable supply of key raw materials and components, which may face shortages, price swings or delivery delays.
